assessment_objectives.objective: credentials for Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identities are stored centrally in a password management tool (e.g., secrets manager or vault).
access to the password management tool holding Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identity credentials is restricted to authorized identities and is logged.
Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identity credentials are not hardcoded in source code, scripts, pipeline definitions, container images or configuration files.
automated scanning detects hardcoded credentials in Control Assurance Automation (CAA) code repositories, pipeline definitions and configuration files, and detected instances are remediated.
